incident-bot: [AUTO] High-severity: routing fallback oscillation detected. Symptom: rapid healthcheck flip-flop across regions (us-east <> us-west <> eu). Elevated 5xx and inter-region tail latency. Investigate: https://ops.internal/runbooks/fallback-oscillation

maria_oncall: I'm on pager. tagging @tay_runtime @noah_sre. Observed spikes correlating with variant alias promotion yesterday evening. Any recent policy changes? :wave:

tay_runtime: pulling probe history now. Looks like the health validator treats variant_tag mismatch as FAIL rather than WARN. We rolled alias small-stable -> redwood-small-q4 at 03:10 UTC. some nodes in us-east still report redwood-small-int8. Fallback policy immediately relocates traffic when health=FAIL, causing the other region to be probed which may have a different variant -> bounce.

tay_runtime: example probe timeline (filtered):
```
2026-03-15T20:54:10Z us-east pool-b probe=PASS variant=redwood-small-int8
2026-03-15T20:54:11Z us-west pool-b probe=FAIL code=503 variant=redwood-small-q4
2026-03-15T20:54:12Z eu pool-b probe=PASS variant=redwood-small-int8
2026-03-15T20:54:12Z us-west pool-b probe=PASS variant=redwood-small-q4
2026-03-15T20:54:13Z us-east pool-b probe=FAIL code=502 variant=redwood-small-q4
2026-03-15T20:54:14Z eu pool-b probe=FAIL code=503 variant=redwood-small-q4
```

noah_sre: Confirming. The health comparator uses exact equality on the model checksum field. Alias promotion changed the reachable binary on some nodes but not the healthcheck payload tag. So healthcheck returns FAIL -> policy flips -> landing region's post-fallback probe runs and fails when variant differs. Loop.

ella_prod: Product note: we intentionally allowed alias-to-variant decoupling for faster rollouts. But rollout tooling should guarantee healthcheck payload parity. We need a short-term mitigation and then a process fix.

vik_cs: Customer impact quick stats: from metrics - 9 tenants saw >3% 5xx in last 15m; one enterprise (tenant id t-4421) experienced bursts of 503 for a 2-3 minute window; CS oncall pinged them. Latency SLO violations recorded for cross-region routed requests.

maria_oncall: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) pause global fallback (set routing.fallback_mode=local-prefer), 2) set healthcheck strictness to WARN for 10m so variant mismatch doesn't equal FAIL, 3) ensure healthcheck payload uses alias-resolved variant during validation. Who can apply? @noah_sre?

noah_sre: I can apply the temp change. Applying policy change via admin API now. Command:
```
POST https://console.internal/api/policies/smart-routing/overrides
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN
Body: {
  "fallback_mode": "local-prefer",
  "healthcheck_strictness": "warn",
  "ephemeral_reason": "mitigate fallback loop 2026-03-15"
}
```

deploy-bot: override applied by noah_sre @ 2026-03-15T20:56:48Z; override_id=ovr_60c2.

tay_runtime: override visible. routing flips reduced immediately. Still seeing a handful of nodes where health probes show variant tags mismatched; will run a targeted sync job to align healthcheck payloads and the aliased variant on the pool.

noah_sre: launching sync: rbctl rollout-verify --alias small-stable --pools pool-b --regions us-east,us-west,eu --fix-mismatch=true

deploy-bot: rollout-verify job queued job_id=rv_881. ETA ~70s.

vik_cs: update: affected customer t-4421 acknowledges fewer errors. Sending templated note: "We mitigated a routing oscillation; engineering is rolling a fix. Will follow up with postmortem."

maria_oncall: job finished. probes now show common variant tag across regions. sample:
```
2026-03-15T20:58:05Z us-east pool-b probe=PASS variant=redwood-small-q4
2026-03-15T20:58:05Z us-west pool-b probe=PASS variant=redwood-small-q4
2026-03-15T20:58:06Z eu pool-b probe=PASS variant=redwood-small-q4
```

noah_sre: Rolling back healthcheck_strictness to normal and removing override in 5m if stable. Also scheduling a short-lived alert: probe_variant_mismatch_rate > 0.2% over 2m -> page.

ella_prod: Follow-ups: (A) add a pre-promotion check that ensures healthcheck payload resolution equals promoted variant across all pools, (B) add 30s debounce on global fallback decisions, (C) update rollout playbook to include immediate post-promotion variant parity scan. I'll open tickets and RFC.

maria_oncall: handoff: @mike_night_oncall taking over monitoring for next 2h. Watch metrics: global_5xx_rate, probe_flip_count, cross_region_routing_rate. If probe_flip_count > 3 per minute re-escalate to eng-runtime.

mike_night_oncall: ack. I'll watch dashboards and log into incident bridge if anything triggers. Anything else to add before I take over?

vik_cs: final CS note: two customers asked for status updates; I've posted a brief to their contacts. Will update #customer-updates.

maria_oncall: incident summary for postmortem: root cause = variant alias promotion without ensuring healthcheck payload parity -> health comparator treated mismatch as FAIL; systemic contributor = routing policy immediate global failover with no debounce; mitigation = policy override to local-prefer + set healthcheck to WARN + force variant parity via rollout-verify; impact = short-lived 5xx spikes and latency increases for a subset of tenants. action items assigned in our tracker.

mike_night_oncall: taking handoff at 21:00Z. will keep thread updated. last_message_ts=1767004022
